headline: Kenya Pipeline Company Foils Fuel Theft Attempt on Mombasa Line
summary: Kenya Pipeline Company reported that it found and secured an illegal connection on its Mombasa pipeline on November 2, resulting in no fuel loss, while police investigate the incident.
why: Pipeline security is crucial for maintaining uninterrupted fuel transport and avoiding environmental and operational losses for energy logistics companies.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Securing fuel transport infrastructure prevents supply disruptions.
